title: Route sip calls to agents by username
summary: Calls to different SIP usernames on one domain land on different agents behind one AgentServer. A routing callback reads the username from the request body and the SDK answers with a 307 to that agent's route.
scenario: A PBX trunk that sends sales@ and workshop@ to one webhook and expects two different agents

evidence: sdk core/mixins/web_mixin.py:1319 register_routing_callback mounts <route>/<path> and turns a returned route into a 307; swml_service.py extract_sip_username reads call.to
sdk agent_server.py:147 setup_sip_routing registers its callback after register() has copied the routes, so it mounts nothing in 3.0.1 (probe 2026-09-02: /sales/sip 404)
